annotations.title: Fees compared: one sale on Etsy, Shopify and Amazon

description: Works out the fees on one sale on Etsy (listing, transaction, processing; Offsite Ads optional), on a Shopify store (card fee by plan through Shopify Payments) and on Amazon (referral fee by category, the Individual plan's per-item fee, an optional FBA fee the seller types), side by side, each column equal to that platform's single fee tool; with orders a month, Shopify's plan and Amazon's Professional plan are spread over each order. It fits a seller who asks which platform takes less of a sale, Etsy vs Shopify vs Amazon fees, or which is cheaper to sell on. Takes the item price and shipping charged; optionally orders a month, the Offsite Ads rate, the Shopify plan, the Amazon category, plan and FBA fee. Returns each platform's fee lines, fixed cost per order, total, what's left and its share of the sale, and which costs least at these numbers, with the caveat that fees are one part of the choice. US dollars; dated rates with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

amazonCategory.description: Amazon: the category, which sets the referral fee. Left out: Everything Else (15%), flagged.

amazonFulfillmentFee.description: Amazon: the FBA fee per unit (Fee Preview in Seller Central) when Amazon ships it. The Amazon sale is then the item price alone (no shipping charged), and the fee replaces the label. Left out: the seller ships, and the buyer pays shippingCharged.

amazonPlan.description: Amazon: professional ($39.99 a month) or individual ($0.99 an item). Left out: professional, flagged.

etsyOffsiteAds.description: Etsy: did the sale come from an Offsite Ad? none, 12-percent (shops past $10,000 a year) or 15-percent. Left out: none, flagged. off is taken as none.

itemPrice.description: The item price on the sale, US dollars, before shipping and tax.

ordersPerMonth.description: Orders a month, 1 to 100,000: spreads the fixed monthly costs (Shopify's plan, Amazon's Professional plan) over each order. Left out: fees on the sale only, before monthly plans (plansCounted false).

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping, US dollars (0 if free).

shopifyBilling.description: Shopify: how the plan is billed, used with ordersPerMonth. Left out: monthly.

shopifyPlan.description: Shopify: the plan, paid through Shopify Payments. Left out: basic, flagged.

name: sellerprofit_compare_fees

amazonShips.description: True when amazonFulfillmentFee was sent: the Amazon sale is the item price alone.

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

columns.description: Etsy, Shopify, Amazon, in that order.

fixed.description: The fixed monthly cost spread over orders; null without ordersPerMonth or when the platform has none counted.

left.description: orderTotal − totalPerOrder: what's left before product cost, packaging, ads and (unless Amazon ships it) the label.

lines.description: Each fee on the sale, each to the cent; they add up to feesOnSale.

moreThanLowest.description: totalPerOrder − the lowest column's totalPerOrder, US dollars: how much more this platform takes than the one that takes least (0 for the lowest).

orderTotal.description: What the buyer pays on this platform, before tax, US dollars.

setup.description: What this column assumes, in a few words.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

lowest.description: The platform (or platforms, at a tie) with the lowest totalPerOrder at these numbers.

plansCounted.description: False without ordersPerMonth: Shopify's plan and Amazon's Professional plan aren't in any total, so the lowest is on the sale's fees alone.

plansNotCounted.description: When plansCounted is false: the monthly plans left out, by name and price. Say it with the lowest.

amazon.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which rates are third-party estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest sit behind the Seller Central login). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.
